title: Paul's bakery opens (paraphrase C)
topic: A baker named Paul opens his new bakery on a Monday morning; the first customers arrive and the shelves are empty by evening
tail_E: At dawn the next day he loads the first trays of dough into the hot
target_note: Same target as formulations A and B: 'oven' is the natural completion of 'loads the first trays of dough into the hot' in the bakery context (dough, loaves, bread scent); it does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent 'Ofen' / 'Backofen'. author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase C of family F06
notes: Formulation C: third independent re-phrasing of the ten F06A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Paul). Replacements include opens his new bakery on a Monday morning/opens his brand-new bakery one Monday morning (neue/nagelneue, an einem Montagmorgen/eines Montagmorgens), kneads the first dough at five/works the first dough at five that morning (knetet um fünf Uhr/bearbeitet an diesem Morgen um fünf), lamps burn in the empty shop/ceiling lamps glow in the deserted shop (Lampen brennen im leeren Laden/Deckenlampen glühen im menschenleeren Laden), neighbor brings flowers to the door/neighbour carries flowers to the doorstep (bringt an die Tür/trägt bis zur Türschwelle), smell of bread fills the street in minutes/scent of bread spreads fast along the street (Duft erfüllt die Straße innerhalb von Minuten/Brotduft verbreitet sich rasch entlang der Straße), first customer buys two loaves at seven/first shopper purchases two loaves at seven o'clock (Kunde kauft/Kunde erwirbt), counts the coins behind the counter/counts the small change at the counter (Münzen hinter der Theke/Kleingeld am Tresen), writes the prices on a small blackboard/notes the prices on a small slate (schreibt auf eine Tafel/vermerkt auf einer Schiefertafel), customers fill the small shop around midday/shoppers pack the small shop around midday (Kunden füllen/Käufer drängen sich, gegen Mittag/um die Mittagszeit), first day ends with empty shelves/first trading day finishes with completely empty shelves (erster Tag/erster Verkaufstag, leeren/völlig leeren). 'oven', 'Ofen' and 'Backofen' are absent. 'eröffnet', 'bearbeitet', 'erwirbt' and 'vermerkt' are inseparable, 'verbreitet sich' and 'drängen sich' are reflexive; no separable verbs ('ausbreiten' avoided). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
